items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: He used to work by Mueller. Yeah, that's right. And he was a bartender for Mueller

ctx.x: Remember Herbert Smith? He had saxophone.

He had Smith's restaurant right here on Johnson. Laparuse. Oh he was a fine-signist. He used to work by Mueller. Yeah, that's right. And he was a bartender for Mueller, he used to be there. Now he's got his on-board. He's got his on-board. He's got his on-board. When they call that place on Last Roundup. Remember Last Roundup?
Yeah. He worked there a long time. Yeah, see, boy that was up Last Roundup.
